newsitem.title: USA: Lazard Freres says unmoved by yield burning ruling.
newsitem.headline: Lazard Freres says unmoved by yield burning ruling.

text.p: Lazard Freres & Co said on Thursday a California court's refusal to dismiss Los Angeles County's "yield burning" case against the firm has not shaken the firm's resolve to win the case.

"Lazard Freres fully expects to show that we do not overcharge our clients and that we undertook our responsibilities as financial adviser to the Los Angeles Metropolitan Transportation Authority with skill and integrity," the firm said in a statement.

The California Supreme Court on March 19 rejected a Lazard petition to dismiss the county's yield burning case against the firm, ending a year of maneuvers by the financial advisor to head off the $14 million challenge filed last year.

Wednesday's decision opens the way for the San Francisco County Superior Court to begin discovery proceedings in the case. The case is the first legal challenge by a municipality to yield burning, which refers to allegations that bond underwriters overcharged states and localities for U.S. Treasury securities they bought to help them refinance their outstanding bonds.
